project: AI Negotiations Platform - Cleanup & UI Polish
description: Polish Google OAuth to blend with theme, make chat history clickable and load negotiations formatted into rounds, and ensure separate dev/prod builds with env files and npm scripts.

ui_layout.auth_placement: OAuth sign-in button in TOP RIGHT corner, styled to blend with header and theme

negotiation_pages.left_side: Chat history sidebar (280px) clickable list showing past negotiations
negotiation_pages.right_side: Main negotiation content area where the selected negotiation loads and is shown in rounds

tasks.details: Update frontend/src/components/auth/SignInButton.tsx to read CSS variables (see ui_layout.theme_variables). Provide props or context override for brandable color. Keep structure using @react-oauth/google but wrap with styled container to blend into header.
tasks.test_instructions: Run dev, open header, verify SignInButton matches --color-accent and hover states.

tasks.task: Add subtle animations and accessible focus states to AuthButton
tasks.details: Add a 150ms scale and shadow animation on hover/focus. Ensure keyboard focus is visible and ARIA attributes present.
tasks.test_instructions: Tab to AuthButton; verify focus ring; hover to see animation.

tasks.task: Expose theme colors to backend-configurable override
tasks.details: Allow an optional FRONTEND_THEME env var (JSON string or URL to theme) so header can be themed for deployments. Provide fallback to CSS variables.
tasks.fixup_needed: Update frontend startup documentation to explain FRONTEND_THEME usage.

tasks.task: Make ChatHistorySidebar list items clickable to load negotiation
tasks.details: Update frontend/src/components/history/ChatHistorySidebar.tsx and NegotiationListItem to call onSelectNegotiation(negotiation.id). Ensure selection state highlights the active item and triggers useNegotiationSession.loadNegotiation(id).
tasks.test_instructions: Create a negotiation, click it in sidebar, verify negotiation loads in main view.

tasks.task: Format loaded negotiation into rounds in UI
tasks.details: Implement formatting for negotiations so messages display grouped into rounds. Each round = one user turn and the corresponding AI responses. Provide a clear visual separation (Round 1, Round 2...). Implement in frontend only by grouping messages by sequence; do NOT change DB yet.
tasks.test_instructions: Load a negotiation with alternating roles and verify grouped rounds show correct pairing and timestamps.

tasks.details: Add migration script (backend/database/migrations/xxx_add_message_round.sql) to add nullable 'round' INTEGER to messages. Backfill round numbers by grouping existing messages by chronological order: every user message increments the round. This task is optional — only do if grouping logic in UI proves insufficient for stable round indexing.
tasks.fixup_needed: Ensure repositories update add_message to accept optional round parameter and update get_messages to return it.

tasks.task: Add 'Load negotiation' spinner and error handling
tasks.details: When clicking a history item, show skeleton spinner in the main panel until messages are fetched. Show friendly error (toast) on failure and retry button.
tasks.test_instructions: Simulate backend failure (400/500) and confirm UI shows retry option.

tasks.details: Add frontend/.env.development and frontend/.env.production with keys: VITE_API_URL, VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, VITE_APP_NAME, optionally FRONTEND_THEME. Add backend/.env.development and backend/.env.production with GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, JWT_SECRET_KEY, FRONTEND_URL.
tasks.test_instructions: Run dev and prod scripts to ensure each picks the correct .env file (see tasks below).

tasks.task: Make npm scripts for separate dev and prod modes
tasks.details: Update frontend/package.json scripts: "dev": "vite --mode development", "prod": "vite build --mode production && vite preview --strictPort --port 5000". Ensure docs explain how to run both locally.
tasks.test_instructions: Run `npm run dev` and confirm app runs on port 3000 (or configured). Run `npm run prod` and confirm built preview serves the production build.

tasks.task: CI: ensure builds use correct mode for deploys
tasks.details: Update CI workflow / deployment scripts to run `npm run prod` for production deploys, and `npm run dev` only for local dev. Provide a short CI snippet in docs.
tasks.test_instructions: If CI exists, run a local simulation of the CI step or dry-run script.

tasks.task: Manual test: Google auth visual & flows
tasks.details: Test sign-in, sign-out, account switching. Verify UI colors and focus states across major browsers. Verify token persisted and /api/auth/me returns user after page reload.
tasks.test_instructions: Perform sign in, reload, verify user still present; sign out and verify token cleared.

tasks.task: Manual test: history click-to-load and rounds formatting
tasks.details: Create several negotiations with mixed user/ai messages. Click several history items and verify correct negotiation loads and rounds are accurate. Test edge cases where negotiation has only AI messages or only user messages.
tasks.test_instructions: Verify round labels, message order, and timestamps.

tasks.details: Update README with new npm scripts, env file info, and theme overrides. Update progress.txt to reflect completed tasks as each iteration finishes.
tasks.test_instructions: Open README and progress.txt and check for accurate instructions.

tasks.details: After all tasks complete, create a release commit with message: "Complete cleanup & UI polish: auth UI, history interactions, env build scripts" and tag v1.1.0.
tasks.test_instructions: Verify tag exists and build artifacts are present for prod.

notes.rationale: Keep changes minimal per iteration. First implement frontend-only grouping & UI polish; only add DB migration if frontend grouping is insufficient.
developer_guidelines: Only work on the FIRST task where done=false
Write tests (manual or unit) where practical
Update progress.txt and prd.json after completing a task
